newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bank stocks up on bond rally.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bank stocks up on bond rally.

text.p: U.S. bank stocks were up sharply Tuesday on a bond market rally, traders and analysts said,
"It's a very powerful move based on the market rally," said George Salem, analyst at Gerard Klauer Mattison.
In late afternoon Citicorp was up four to 104-1/2, Chase Manhattan Corp was up 2-3/8 to 89-7/8 and BankAmerica Corp was up three to 102-1/2.

A trader noted that bank stocks had been underperforming the overall stock market since November when U.S. interest rates started to creep up. The 30-year Treasury issue was up one point with the yield slipping to 6.77 percent.
